title: Protocol for evaluation and validation of TLR8 antagonists in HEK-Blue cells via secreted embryonic alkaline phosphatase assay
protocol: Wash cultured HEK-Blue TLR8 cells in 10 cm dishes with 5 mL PBS three times gently.
Add 10 mL of DMEM medium to the dish and harvest cells by aspiration.
Pass medium through a 10 mL serological pipette ten times to separate cells.
Spin HEK-Blue TLR8 cells at 300×g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant into bleach and resuspend cell pellet with DMEM medium.
Seed HEK-Blue TLR8 cells in tissue culture treated 96-well flat-bottom clear plates with a density of 7.5 × 10^4 cells/well in DMEM test media.
Activate TLR8 in HEK-Blue TLR8 cells using R848.
Treat DMSO (0.1%) treated cells as negative control (three replicates).
Treat cells with R848 (1 μg/mL) for positive control (three replicates).
Test TLR8 antagonists by treating cells with both R848 (1 μg/mL) and various concentrations of appropriate TLR8 antagonists.
Start treatment with TLR8 antagonist compound 4 at a concentration of 10 μM and use serial dilution of 1:4.
Incubate plates in humidified incubators containing 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 h.
Transfer 30 μL of culture media to a 96-well flat-bottom clear plate after 24 hours.
Add 100 μL of Quanti-Blue to the plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C until the color changes to dark blue (30 min–1 h).
Quantify absorbance at 620 nm using a Beckman-Coulter DTX 880 Multimode Detector.
Normalize readout of R848 treated cells as 100% activation.
Consider untreated cells as 0% activation.
Wash HEK-Blue TLR8 cells very gently with PBS.
Add PBS slowly to the bottom of tilted cell culture dishes.
Swirl the dishes carefully to wash cells.
Avoid using wells around the edges of 96-well plates.
Cultured HEK-Blue TLR8 cells in 10 cm dishes were washed with 5 mL PBS three times gently.
Add 10 mL of DMEM medium to the dish.
Harvest cells from the dishes by aspirating.
Pass the medium through a 10 mL serological pipette ten times to separate cells.
Centrifuge cells at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant into bleach.
Resuspend the cell pellet with DMEM medium.
Seed HEK-Blue TLR8 cells in tissue culture treated 96-well flat-bottom clear plates at a density of 7.5 × 10^4 cells per well using DMEM test media.
Mix R848 with cells at a concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Treat cells with various concentrations of TLR8 antagonists, starting at 10 μM and using serial dilutions of 1:4.
Incubate plates in humidified incubators containing 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 hours.
Remove and discard the supernatant after 24-hour incubation.
Add 100 μL of a 1:10 diluted WST-1 solution in DMEM to each well as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate plate at 37°C until color changes (approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour).
Quantify absorbance at 450 nm using Beckman-Coulter DTX 880 Multimode Detector.
Wash cultured HEK-Blue cells overexpressing TLR1-9 in 10 cm dishes with 5 mL PBS three times gently.
Add 10 mL of DMEM medium to the dish and harvest cells from the dish by aspiration.
Pass the medium through a 10 mL serological pipette for ten times to separate cells.
Centrifuge cells at 300×g for five minutes at 4°C, discard supernatant into bleach, and resuspend cell pellet with DMEM medium.
Seed HEK-Blue TLR cells in tissue culture treated 96-well flat-bottom clear plates with a density of 7.5 × 10^4 cells/well in DMEM test media.
Treat HEK-Blue cells overexpressing TLRs other than TLR8 with corresponding agonists and antagonists.
Incubate plates in humidified incubators containing 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 h.
Transfer 30 μl of culture media to a new 96 well flat bottom clear plate after about 24 h.
Add 100 μl of Quanti-Blue to the transferred culture media.
Incubate the plate at 37°C until color changes (30 min-1 h).
Quantify absorbance at 620 nm using Beckman-Coulter DTX 880 Multimode Detector.
Prepare buffer composed of 25 mM MES pH 5.5, 0.20 M NaCl, and 2.5% DMSO at 25°C using a MicroCal iTC200 (GE Healthcare, Illinois, USA).
Dissolve TLR8 inhibitors in buffer to a final concentration of 100 μM.
Dissolve TLR8 protein in buffer to a final concentration of 10 μM.
Fill the calorimeter syringe with ligand solution according to instrument manual instructions.
Inject 100 μM inhibitors into 10 μM hTLR8 as instructed by the instrument manual.
Include a single 0.4 μL injection followed by 18 injections, each of 2 μL, with a spacing of 120 s between injections.
Use OriginLab software to analyze the raw ITC data.
Fit data points in OriginLab as instructed in the instrument manual.
Seed THP-1 cells in 6-well plates at a density of 2 × 10^6 cells per well using RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% FBS, PenStrep, 2 mM L-glutamine, and 0.05 mM 2-mercaptoethanol.
Treat THP-1 cells with PMA at a concentration of 100 ng/mL to stimulate their differentiation into macrophage-like phenotypes.
Incubate the treated cells in humidified incubators containing 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 hours.
Remove the supernatant and replace it with unsupplemented RPMI medium.
Treat the differentiated THP-1 cells with R848 (1 μg/mL) along with various concentrations of TLR8 antagonists (0, 5, 50, 500 nM).
Incubate the treated cells for 2 hours.
Incubate THP-1 cells for 2 hours.
Collect THP-1 cells after incubation.
Add 100 μl ice-cold CER I to the cell pellet and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Add 5.5 μl ice-cold CER II and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 16,000×g for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant and collect the pellet.
Add 50 μl ice-cold NER to the pellet.
Incubate the sample on ice, vortexing every 10 minutes for a total of 40 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 16,000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant for further assay.
Measure protein levels of samples using BCA assay according to manufacturer’s manual.
Load 20 μg of each sample onto a 10% Tris-glycine SDS-PAGE gel and run the electrophoresis.
Transfer proteins from the gel onto a nitro-cellulose membrane using electroblotting.
Block the membrane with milk in TBST for 1 hour at 25°C.
Incubate the membrane with NF-κB P65 primary antibody (1:1000) in BSA buffer overnight at 4°C.
Wash the membrane three times with TBST, 5 minutes each.
Incubate the membrane with peroxidase-conjugated Goat Anti-Rabbit IgG secondary antibody (1:1000) dissolved in TBST (5% milk) for 1 hour at 25°C.
Wash the membrane three times with TBST, 5 minutes each.
Visualize blots using Thermo SuperSignal West Pico kit.
Use Lamin A/C as an internal control for nuclear fractions.
